text:
Carlos (CS): FYI - PhysioCore onboarding has intermittent tail latency spikes on /v1/chat (p95 jumped ~700ms in last 48h). Renewal check-in in 4 days. Thinking of a conservative perf hedge: prefer redwood-kite-6B-int4 for short/medium summaries and keep gpu-13B for long-context docs. want to run a short canary + quick QA on the clinician_note_suite.

Mira (Solutions): can you share p50/p95 and average token lengths so i can run cost/latency calc? also, any recent infra changes?

Carlos (CS): p50 ~260ms, p95 ~960ms, avg payload ~140 tokens but many 400+ token docs. no infra changes reported; looks correlated with larger batch imports at ~02:00 UTC.

Ravi (SRE): sounds like KV cache pressure during bulk imports. routing by size + spillover should help. i'll also throttle import concurrency during the canary windows.

Mira (Solutions): proposed steps: 1) offline eval on clinician_note_suite (metrics: entity-f1, ROUGE-L, hallucination rate); 2) routing rule: prefer redwood-kite-6B-int4 for requests where request.tokens <= 700; 3) canary 12% for 12h; 4) auto-rollback if feedback rate >1.2% in 30m or automated hallucination >0.8%.

Dr. Chen (Customer): clinicians need a way to flag bad summaries quickly. please add a small feedback button and a reason dropdown (missing follow-up / wrong med / unclear). auto-rollback required for clinician flows.

Carlos (CS): noted. assigning: @Mira run offline eval + A/B artifact, @Ravi stand up canary + rollback, @Dr. Chen enable feedback toggle. i'll add a short note to the renewal packet.

deploy-bot: please create canary record.

deploy-bot: Canary created (id: canary-8219991234). Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8219991234

Ravi (SRE): canary live. initial metrics streaming: canary group p95=430ms, baseline p95=980ms. quick smoke QA (n=20): phrasing differences in 4/20, no incorrect meds found. feedback widget enabled.

Mira (Solutions): offline eval (clinician_note_suite) started. rough projection: expected token-cost reduction ~42% for routed requests, latency improvement on p95 ~55% for those requests. if entity-F1 delta <1.5% and hallucination <1% we recommend ramp to 60% over 48h.

Dr. Chen (Customer): feedback toggle live. flagged 1 output for being too terse (reason: missing follow-up). added free-text note.

Ravi (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate 0.7% after 3h. continuing to stream alerts to #cs-renewals.

Mira (Solutions): eval finished: entity-F1 delta -0.8%, ROUGE-L drop 0.9, hallucination automated check 0.3%. artifacts uploaded to renewal bucket.

Carlos (CS): adding renewal brief note: "Executed conservative routing canary to redwood-kite-6B-int4; observed ~50% reduction in p95 for routed traffic with projected cost savings ~40%; quality within guardrails. recommend ramp plan in packet." will include flagged examples in slides.

Dr. Chen (Customer): thanks team. appreciate the cautious approach and the feedback loop. keep the clinicians' toggle on during ramp.

Ravi (SRE): next step: ramp to 50% in 12h if no regressions; keep auto-rollback and import throttles in place. will update thread with ramp metrics. :rocket:
